name: Pool generator
description: A swimming pool or fountain, rectangular, L-shaped, round or freeform: the concrete shell, steps, benches, tiles, coping, paving with a gated barrier, filter, pump, connected pipes and a machine room, with quantities, bars and an IFC file. Norms come from spec side add-ons. A drawing aid: an engineer must design the pool.
author: CadCraft
